integrity: The proof is analytic. No numerical experiment, unpublished external result, or independence claim is used. Literature comparisons were made against the recent frame-spread source and primary MUB tomography/design sources.
scientific_limitations: The sharp incomplete-MUB example assumes prime-power dimension so that a complete set of \(d+1\) mutually unbiased bases is available.
The result concerns one fixed rank-one POVM repeated independently and does not cover adaptive, collective, or shared-randomness protocols.
No global characterization of non-informationally-complete POVMs with frame spread near \(1\) is claimed.
title: Near-minimal frame spread can coexist with maximal entropy nonidentifiability
